title: Key West Nighttime Full Moon Sail
blurb: Sail around Key West on a romantic, nighttime sailing experience aboard Schooner America 2.0! This 1.5-hour sail by moonlight is perfect for date night or an evening out with family and friends. Departing in the evening as the moon comes up over Key West, enjoy star gazing opportunities and a moonlit sky as the boat glides through the majestic waters at night.
